config.label: Your SchoolPass parent account email address
config.description: Your SchoolPass parent account email address.

config.label: The numeric school id (AppCode) SchoolPass uses to select your school
config.description: The numeric school id (AppCode) SchoolPass uses to select your school.

config.label: Optional regional API host override (default busapi-east16-ss
config.description: Optional regional API host override (default busapi-east16-ss.school-pass.net).

config.label: The school's IANA timezone (e
config.description: The school's IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York), used for the "today" default of the calendar and pickup-change reads. Defaults to the server's local zone; set it when the server runs elsewhere (a hosted server runs in UTC, so evening defaults would otherwise point at tomorrow).

config.label: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start
config.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

config.label: Absolute path for the session cache file
config.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.schoolpass-mcp/session.json.
